_note:
Shared values used in more than one place on the site — entered ONCE here and referenced everywhere else, so an address or a link has a single source of truth.

HOW TO USE A VALUE. In a link field, type #brand-email (or #brand-instagram, etc.) instead of the address. In ordinary text, type [brand phone] and it is replaced where it stands. Both are resolved on the server when the page renders.

An email becomes a mailto: link and a phone becomes a tel: link automatically, so do not type those prefixes here — just the address or the number.

Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`; never hand-edit an acf.json.

name.label: Business name
name.doc: Used wherever the company is named in copy.

email.label: Email address
email.doc: The general enquiries address. Referenced as #brand-email in a link, or [brand email] in text. Becomes a mailto: link on its own — type just the address.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.doc: Written the way it should READ on the page, e.g. (760) 555-0134. Becomes a tel: link on its own, with everything except digits and a leading + stripped for the dialling part.

address.label: Address
address.doc: Shown on the contact page and anywhere the location is named.

careers_email.label: Careers email
careers_email.doc: Where job enquiries go, if different from the general address. Referenced as #brand-careers_email.

instagram.label: Instagram
instagram.doc: Full https:// address of the profile. Leave blank and nothing linking to it shows.

facebook.label: Facebook
facebook.doc: Full https:// address. Leave blank and nothing linking to it shows.

tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.doc: Full https:// address. Leave blank and nothing linking to it shows.

linkedin.label: LinkedIn
linkedin.doc: Full https:// address. Leave blank and nothing linking to it shows.

privacy.label: Privacy policy page
privacy.doc: Path or full address of the privacy policy.

footer_logo.label: Footer logo
footer_logo.doc: The lockup shown in the middle of the footer on every page. It is artwork, not type — the words beside it in the code are only what a screen reader announces. An SVG keeps it crisp at any size; a PNG around 1400px wide also works. Leave empty to keep the built-in Blacktop lockup.

footer_logo_size.label: Footer logo width
footer_logo_size.doc: How wide the footer logo is, in pixels. It has been 360 at full width, which reads small on a wide screen. It never grows past the space available, so a large number here simply means 'as big as it fits' on a phone.

admin_menu_title.label: Menu name
admin_menu_title.doc: What this whole area is called in the black sidebar on the left. It is "Section Content" today. Changing it renames the menu only — no page, address or saved content moves.

admin_menu_icon.label: Menu icon — built-in
admin_menu_icon.doc: A Dashicons name — the icon set WordPress ships with — for example dashicons-layout, dashicons-art or dashicons-screenoptions. The full list is at developer.wordpress.org/resource/dashicons. Ignored entirely if you upload your own below.

admin_menu_position.label: Where it sits in the sidebar
admin_menu_position.doc: Lower numbers sit higher. 2 puts it directly under Dashboard, at the very top, which is what it is set to. Posts is 5, Media 10, Pages 20, Appearance 60. A number already taken by another plugin can make one of the two disappear, so move in steps of 2.

admin_menu_icon_image.label: Menu icon — your own
admin_menu_icon_image.doc: Upload or pick an icon from the Media Library instead. It wins over the built-in name beside it. A small square works best — WordPress draws it at 20 by 20 pixels — and a white or very light PNG or SVG reads properly against the dark sidebar. Leave it empty to use the built-in icon.

admin_menu_pages.label: Order of the pages inside it
admin_menu_pages.doc: DRAG THE ROWS to set the order they appear in the sidebar. Add a row per page you want to place; anything you leave out keeps its usual position after the ones you list, so you can add just two rows to pull those two to the top. Leave the list empty for the order they are generated in.
